'di ni rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab byams mngon nas || thogs med dbyig gnyen blo brtan gang ba spel || rin chen rdo rje pad? ja na dang ni || chos kyi dbang phyug lcang ra ldum? ston dang || rtum? ston chu mig pa dang dpal ldan gro || sgom seng rin chen bla ma rin chen gsal || kun dga' tshul khrims grags pa'i rgyal mtshan las || brgyud te ma ti bdag la gnang pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
